openingActions.summary: Kills a mystai as the party awakens; a new shadow rises from her withered body before initiative is rolled.

entries.summary: Two shadows rush a mystai: the first hits and badly injures him; the next attack kills him, leaving his body shriveled.
Panics and runs away from everyone into the dark.

Leaves the pool, lines up two shadows and casts Lightning Bolt for a rolled 31 lightning damage. The nearest fails its save and disintegrates; the second succeeds, takes damage and survives. The flash reveals six remaining shadows.
entries.note: The saving-throw ability is not stated in this first casting; no external rules are supplied.

entries.summary: Creates a floating magnesium fire pit in the flaming pool; it ignites and sheds about 30 feet of bright light. Warns everyone to stay in the light and gives Wellby a d8 Bardic Inspiration as a glowing arrow rune.

Bonds Kenzo and Delwath (correcting an initial reference to Seeker): while within 30 feet of each other they may add a d4 to one attack roll, ability check or saving throw per turn. Steps into the illuminated pool.
Moves beside Delwath and readies an attack for when he has a weapon.
Wades out to engage a shadow while staying within the bond’s range. One near miss becomes a 17 hit with the d4; further unarmed strikes leave it barely alive, then he spends ki and finishes it.
Hands Wellby a magical shadow bow and hits the shadow in front of him with two Eldritch Blasts; it remains barely alive.

Releases his held bow attack at Delwath’s wounded target. It misses even with the inspiration d8. The expended rune explodes; the shadow fails its Constitution save, takes thunder damage equal to that inspiration roll, and survives.

Two shadows close and attack in bright light. Disadvantage prevents the first hit from being a critical: Seeker takes 9 necrotic damage and loses 1 Strength. The second attack also hits for 6 necrotic and another 2 Strength, total loss 3.
Two shadows move toward Delwath with disadvantage. The first misses AC 12 with rolls 11 and 7; the next deals 10 necrotic damage and reduces his Strength by 3.
After the last nearby enemy’s turn, uses his reaction to move without provoking opportunity attacks.
entries.note: Declared retrospectively after the mystai narration; placed immediately after the triggering enemy turn.

entries.summary: Tries to return toward the light without running toward the shadows.

Lines up three shadows with a second Lightning Bolt, rolled 34 lightning damage. The nearest fails its save; the other two succeed. One already-damaged shadow is vaporized; the shadow by Kenzo is badly hurt, the one by Delwath less so. Lightning resistance reduces damage; later clarification gives the twice-reduced damage as 7. Returns to the water.
Casts Shatter on two shadows: one succeeds and one fails the Constitution save. Gives Candrosa Bardic Inspiration.

Calls the surviving mystai close and casts Sanctuary on Seeker: an attacker must pass a Wisdom save; Seeker attacking, damaging or casting an enemy-affecting spell ends it. A burst of radiant energy targets the shadow beside Delwath; it fails a Dexterity save and takes 1 radiant damage, which is unusually effective.

Stays still for Steady Aim and shoots with advantage. A 16 hits the shadow near Seeker and the surviving mystai for 20 stated damage; the bow’s +1 damage is acknowledged afterward. The shadow survives.
entries.note: The source does not explicitly settle a revised total after the +1 reminder.

entries.summary: Uses Fist of the Planar on the shadow across the pool: it fails its Strength save and is destroyed. A bonus-action punch hits the adjacent shadow; resistance halves the damage and it survives. The proposed additional flurry is disallowed after this action.

Abandons the proposed curse and point-blank attack after learning Eldritch Blast would have disadvantage. Teleports away instead, then fires twice at the same shadow; the first deals 2 damage and the second leaves it nearly dead.
Fails the Wisdom save to attack Seeker through Sanctuary, moves to Delwath and hits despite disadvantage. Deals 10 damage and drains 2 more Strength, leaving Delwath at 3 Strength.
Both miss Kenzo with disadvantage; they reposition so another straight lightning bolt cannot catch both.
Moves beside Candrosa and takes the Dodge action.
Creates a Flaming Sphere and slams a shadow. It succeeds on its Dexterity save, takes half the fire damage and remains alive. Drikod moves next to the weakened ally.
Withdraws from the shadow, which attempts an opportunity attack, and casts second-level Healing Word on Delwath for 9 healing.
Attempts the opportunity attack triggered by Seeker’s withdrawal but fails the Wisdom save against Sanctuary and cannot make the attack.
entries.note: Occurs during Seeker’s movement, before the remainder of his turn.

entries.summary: Withdraws the proposed Protection from Good and Evil and casts Warding Bond on Delwath instead: +1 AC and saving throws, resistance to all damage, with Candrosa sharing damage Delwath takes.
Uses Steady Aim and fires with advantage, but misses; he has no inspiration remaining.
Uses Fist of the Planar on the shadow beside Delwath. It fails its Strength save, survives the initial damage and is pulled 20 feet toward Kenzo. His bonus-action punch kills it.

Curses the shadow beside Kenzo and kills it with Eldritch Blast force damage. Healing is described without a number. A second Eldritch Blast destroys the last shadow; the stated 15 is enough to kill it.
entries.note: The speaker says Kenzo looks healed after the curse kill; the beneficiary is internally unclear and has not been silently reassigned to Delwath.

combats.note: The party begins unarmored and without weapons but can use spell foci; ritual water breathing and harmless blue flames remain active. The opening and early enemy turns precede the first fully narrated PC cycle; grouping preserves resolved sequence without deriving elapsed time.

ending.summary: The last shadow is destroyed and the encounter ends. Seven shadows fought here (six pursuers plus one spawned from the first slain mystai); two mystai died and one survived. Delwath and Seeker suffered Strength drain.
